description.value: Magnolia Bakery opened its first store in NYC’s West Village neighborhood on the corner of Bleecker Street and West 11th Street in 1996. The original shop is at 401 Bleecker St, New York, NY 10014. Come for a cupcake or the famous banana pudding, and expect a line in the evening.
